_source: Synthetic — CustomSql dataset whose LogicalTableMap CreateColumnsOperation adds FIVE window/table-calc columns spanning every translated family: runningSum (running), stdevOver (statistical), percentileOver (windowed PERCENTILE_CONT), percentileRank (PERCENT_RANK), and periodToDateSumOverTime YEAR (date-anchored YTD). The CustomSql synthesizes a real ORDER_DATE (DATE) from the YYYYMMDD ORDER_DATE_KEY and surfaces REGION so the partition/period anchors resolve to real warehouse columns. Each calc must lower to a kind:'sql' helper element with an explicit OVER / WITHIN GROUP clause and resolve to a concrete (non-error) column at query time (beads-sigma-woaa + statistical/periodToDate extension).

CustomSql.Name: orders_window
CustomSql.SqlQuery: select f.ORDER_ID, f.NET_REVENUE, f.ORDER_DATE_KEY, TO_DATE(TO_VARCHAR(f.ORDER_DATE_KEY), 'YYYYMMDD') as ORDER_DATE, c.REGION from CSA.TJ.ORDER_FACT f left join CSA.TJ.CUSTOMER_DIM c on f.CUSTOMER_KEY = c.CUSTOMER_KEY
